# Zuvio

> Independent car rental marketplace connecting renters with local agencies across the US. Cash accepted, no credit card required.

Zuvio helps independent rental agencies and Turo hosts get direct bookings without middlemen. Owners keep their pricing, policies, and customer relationships while reaching renters nationwide.

- [Home](/): Independent car rental platform overview for owners and renters.
